vendor adds sec_event_ring/sched_tm/tsa hooks used only by drivers/usb/core/usb.c; building them against 5.15's TRB/URB internals is a real MTK USB porting task, not a mechanical port. usb.c held at base too (see its entry).

vendor thermal core gained MTK notify-mode plumbing (mtk_get_therm_zone_device, __thermal_zone_device_get/set_notify_mode, thermal_zone_set_trips). Callers are vendor-new files outside the 5.15 Kbuild, so the port had applied the definition side but not the declaration side (thermal_core.h is not in the changed-file set) -> -Werror=missing-prototypes. Whole cluster held at base: deferred to the thermal-porting milestone; no 5.15 code regressed.

vendor ULMK/lowmemorykiller feature (wake_ulmk_kthread, ulmk_shrink_node_state, record_vmpressure) plus 4.19's dead_special_task()/task_unlock-before-put_task_struct() rewrite of find_lock_task_mm(). 5.15's mm internals make this a genuine porting job (and 5.15 already dropped dead_special_task); holding these four files plus the header keeps mm/ and kernel/exit.c compiling and self-consistent.

5.15 removed the u64-serialisers unix_stream_send/recvmsg and renamed the gadget start/stop hooks; those vendor hunks are the 4.19 API shape and cannot be mechanically carried. No 5.15 code was lost (base af_unix.o/musb_gadget.o built clean; the ported gadget header kept its in-place edits, so nothing referenced removed prototypes).

base 5.15 Makefile lists clk-chk-{mt2701,mt2712,mt6797,mt8173,mt8183,mt8186,mt8192,mt8195}.o which the ported Makefile dropped while still building vendor clk-chk-mt6765/mt6768/mt6779/mt6795/mt6779.c -> undefined refs to mt2701/mt6795/mt8183/mt8186/mt8195_clk_dump, mtk_clk_dump, clk_dump_register and clkchk_init. Fixed by restoring the whole base file list (vendor entries kept), transplanting vendor clkchk.c+clkchk.h for clkchk_init, and stripping the three vendor-only mt6779/mt6795 clkchk glue lines (their .c files exist in no tree).

the earlier glue-strip removed the ENTIRE 'obj-y += drm/ vga/ mediatek/' line from drivers/gpu/Makefile to drop one missing vendor dir, which silently disabled the whole DRM subsystem, the DRM core objects and the VGA arbiter -> 8 link errors (vga_client_register, vga_default_device, devm_drm_of_get_bridge, of_drm_find_panel(s), drm_panel_*_get_bus_flags, mtk_smi_larb_gen1_pm_runtime_*). Both Makefiles restored from v5.15.220 (only the nonexistent vendor drm/mediatek/mtk/tcon/ line stripped) and the 4.19-only CONFIG_VGA_ARB/TRUSTED_KEYS/EFI/EFI_ESRT/EFI_VARS off via scripts/config, exactly as the device's even_defconfig has them. drivers/gpu/vga/ now builds, so VGA_ARB is enabled as upstream's Kconfig defaults it.

the ported hunks rewrote the #include lines of 7 upstream-only board DTS (mt6755-evb.dts, mt6795-evb.dts, mt6797-evb.dts, mt6797-x20-dev.dts, mt2712e.dtsi, ...) to downstream-only paths, breaking 17 of 521 DTB builds. Reverted; make dtbs now exits 0 with 528 DTBs. The even board tree is a vendor-new file and is not affected (see the DTS milestone).

this sandbox has no OpenSSL, and CONFIG_SYSTEM_TRUSTED_KEYRING=y makes certs/Makefile run scripts/extract-cert with the (empty) key list. A stand-in implementing exactly that one case was compiled into the build object tree as the gitignored artifact kbuild would have produced; it exits non-zero for any non-empty key list so it can never silently mis-build a trust chain, and no file in the kernel source tree was patched.

full `make modules` exposed the last vendor clusters: videobuf2-core.c used the vendor static helper __buffers_in_use() and re-exported v4l2_get_link_freq (5.15 moved it to drivers/media/v4l2-core/, so the port produced a duplicate __kstrtab symbol), and net/bluetooth/hci_core.c failed on a const-qualified strscpy argument. 23 affected files reverted (include/media/videobuf2-core.h, include/uapi/linux/videodev2.h, drivers/media/common/videobuf2, drivers/media/usb/uvc, net/bluetooth).
